title: Buschingstraße, Munich
description:
Welcome to your new room in the heart of Munich! 
You’ll find it located on the fifth floor in a completely renovated Apartment which includes three rooms in total, Along with a kitchen including all appliances and a washer dryer, a bathroom with a modern glass shower and all round new ceramics. 
You’ll share the communal space with two quiet housemates. 

The room itself has a big window with a fairly green view, and is already set for your arrival offering a bed with mattress, a closet, a table and a chair for you to work or study at.
The building uses a central heating system with individually controlled radiators in every room, so it’s always cozy and warm to your liking. 
Included in the rent are all utilities like power, heating, water and also WIFI. 

The U-Bahn / subway station „Böhmerwaldplatz“ is reached on foot in five minutes, from there you’ll reach the city center at Odeonsplatz in ten minutes. 
The LMU is reached in 20 minutes from your doorstep, the TUM in 25 minutes all using public transport.
Additionally there also os a bus stop.  There is a modern EDEKA supermarket only five minutes away, as well as REWE and Teegut supermarket, along with a dry-cleaner‘s, multiple bakery’s like IHLE and others, and a variety of restaurants among them a L‘Osteria and the Michelin starred restaurant Aquarello all in a 15 minute walking radius. 
Additionally just two bus stops away there is a shopping center. 
The park „Denniger Anger“ is located directly adjacent to the Building. 

All in all this room is your perfect base to explore and enjoy Munich. 
If you have any questions you’re most welcome to drop me a message, I’ll be glad to assist.

Willkommen in deinem neuen Zimmer im Herzen von München! Es befindet sich im fünften Stock eines komplett sanierten Apartments, das insgesamt drei Zimmer umfasst. Hinzu kommen eine Küche – ausgestattet mit allen Elektrogeräten sowie Waschmaschine und Trockner – und ein Badezimmer mit moderner Glasdusche und rundum neuen Sanitärobjekten. Die Gemeinschaftsräume teilst du dir mit zwei ruhigen Mitbewohnern. Das Zimmer selbst verfügt über ein großes Fenster mit Blick ins Grüne und ist bereits für deinen Einzug vorbereitet: Es bietet ein Bett samt Matratze, einen Kleiderschrank sowie einen Tisch und einen Stuhl zum Arbeiten oder Studieren. Das Gebäude wird über eine Zentralheizung versorgt; dank individuell regulierbarer Heizkörper in jedem Zimmer ist es stets gemütlich und warm – ganz nach deinen Wünschen. In der Miete sind sämtliche Nebenkosten wie Strom, Heizung, Wasser sowie WLAN bereits enthalten. Die U-Bahn-Station „Böhmerwaldplatz“ ist zu Fuß in nur fünf Minuten erreichbar; von dort gelangst du in zehn Minuten ins Stadtzentrum am Odeonsplatz. Die LMU erreichst du von deiner Haustür aus in 20 Minuten, die TUM in 25 Minuten – jeweils bequem mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln. Zusätzlich befindet sich eine Bushaltestelle in unmittelbarer Nähe. Ein moderner EDEKA-Supermarkt ist nur fünf Minuten entfernt; ebenso befinden sich REWE und Tegut, eine chemische Reinigung, diverse Bäckereien (wie IHLE und andere) sowie eine Vielzahl von Restaurants – darunter eine L‘Osteria und das mit einem Michelin-Stern ausgezeichnete Restaurant Aquarello – alle im Umkreis von 15 Gehminuten. Nur zwei Bushaltestellen entfernt liegt zudem ein Einkaufszentrum. Der Park „Denninger Anger“ grenzt direkt an das Gebäude an. Alles in allem ist dieses Zimmer der perfekte Ausgangspunkt, um München zu erkunden und zu genießen. Falls du Fragen hast, schreib mir gerne eine Nachricht – ich helfe dir jederzeit gerne weiter!

title: Schweppermannstraße, Munich
description:
Munich’s tantalizing high tech & culture campus ‚Werksviertel‘ next to Ostbahnhof:

Quiet, bright 3.5 room flat
with ‚sun downer‘ balcony and view of the alpine range
Fully furnished and equipped

the cut and furniture is particularly suitable for ExPats, i.e. professional singles or couples on a project assignment lasting ideally between 12 and 36 months, or longer. For rental periods between 6 and less then 12 months, there is a short time supplement of € 150 per month. A move-in earlier than 1st of May might be possible.

* pls consider: it is unfortunately NOT suitable for students to share the flat, nor for families with more than 1 kid (school aged), sorry *
Perfect for couples, very generous for singles

Highlights

    • Central location right behind ‚Ostbahnhof‘ hub with excellent transport links
    • Up-and-coming, dynamic environment between ‚Werksviertel‘, Kultfabrik, Future Philharmonic Hall, Technical City Hall and Telekom Towers
    • Nevertheless very quiet, very low traffic neighbourhood
    • bedroom window opening to the calm & green patio
    • High-quality renovation with waxed oak parquet flooring, white tiles in kitchen & bathroom
    • white insulating tripple glass tilt & turn windows w. adjustable sun blinds
    • West-facing balcony on the top floor with the longest evening sun around 
    • Spacious entrance area w. hallway, 26sqm/280sqft  living & dining room
    • separate WC
    • State-of-the-art kitchenette with 3-zone fridge-freezer, indirect LED lighting & induction cook top
    • fully equipped with modern & up-to-date quality equipment, dishes, cutlery, pottery, glasses etc.
    • fully fitted up-to-date living room with large 55“ SmarTV with googleTV & denon sound system
    • separate home office room with prof. work place furniture (and/or for 1 school kid)
    • optional underground parking space, free street parking


The flat

Very well cut, 3 room apartment with 71sqm/767sqft living space (‚heated‘, available space approx. 74 sqm/800sqft). From the moment you first enter, the flat appears surprisingly spacious due to the combination of entrance and hallway. This is underlined by the high-quality, semi-dark waxed solid oak parquet flooring. All rooms, including a separate WC, are accessible from there, so there are no rooms with passageways.

Directly at the entrance, opposite the coat rack, is a bright study, children's room or home office equipped with a modern professional work place. To the right from the large hallway in the middle, you find the white-tiled kitchen with a very high-quality kitchenette fitted with all up-to-date quality appliances. Opposite across the hallway you enter the large, light-flooded living & dining room with a large window front towards the west and access to the balcony. Thanks to its location on the top of six floors, you can enjoy the evening sun here winter and summer until the very end, even after a long working day. Bistro style chairs and table are available for your sun downer drinks with colleagues, family or friends.

At the end of the hallway is the bathroom and, directly next to it, the bedroom facing to the very quiet, green inner patio. Right opposite to the square shaped bedroom, there is also a practical niche with a built-in wardrobe and integrated full size mirror in the hallway, so right between bed room and bath room. Thus a seamless, on-the-fly professional dress-up in the morning is ensured.

In general, the flat on the top floor is very bright and quiet, and can nevertheless be reached comfortably throughout from the ground level or underground car park using the lift. Or the stair case for an ‚integrated free-of-charge physical exercise‘. Thanks to the ensemble's opening to the southeast, the Alpine peak chain can be admired from the flat on a clear day. 


Furniture and Equipment

All rooms are equipped with modern, white framed insulating triple-glass windows, as well as adjustable external sun blinds, such that not only darkening but also glare-free daylight can be ensured. All rooms are heated via a central gas heating system in (hidden)ment. Nevertheless the insulation and thus energy efficiency of the building is quite high (95.2 kWh/m2 - energy classification certificate available), so, apart of the bath room, you’ll might only need it on a view cold winter days.

The bathroom has six-foot high tiling, a washbasin and a full-size bath tub with a shower curtain and modern single-lever mixer taps. The floor is covered with foot-warm vinyl tiles in a structured slate design and solid oak skirting boards; there is also a wall cupboard, towel rails and a washing brand-new machine as well as an automatic air ventilation. A drying room is also available in (hidden)ment for the winter. The separate WC has a wall-mounted, rimless flush bowl for maximum of hygiene and a hand wash basin with mirror. Towels can be provided on request (inclusive).

The bedroom is dominated by a large double bed of 180x210cm (just short of king size: 71“x82“) with adjacent night shelves and LED reading spots including USB charging option. A large room-high wardrobe with sophisticated partitioning, shelves, drawers and automatic indirect lighting, offering space for most divers clothing demands, is hidden behind full room size dim white sliding doors. Pillows, covers and bed linen are provided. 

The kitchen is equipped with modern wall cupboards and pull-outs, a high-gloss splash back, indirect LED lighting, as well as a high-quality induction hob, extractor fan and oven, all from Siemens, as well as a dishwasher. This is complemented by a free-standing Bosch fridge-freezer with zero-degree compartments ('Crisper-/Fresh-Box') in a stainless steel look. There also is a small folding table with two bar stools for the quick working day breakfast. All china, glasses, cutlery, pots & pans, as well as other kitchen utensils are available – of course including a coffee machine.

The combined living & dining room comprises a large glass-top round table situated next to the balkonny also equipped with bistro style table & chairs, enabling an easy switch between in- and out-door depending on weather.

The living section of the room offers a reading niche with a small table as well as a three seat sofa with a recammière and a coffee table. Next to that across the entire wall you can enjoy a  brand new most up-to-date media wall including a large 55“ Thomson smartTV supporting androidTV etc. and a Denon digital sound system all brand new.

Finally the flats functionality is completed with a separate study equipped with a professional work desk, office chair, mobile pedestal and side boards. The room could optionally also be used as a nursery.


Location and get to & away

Excellent, central and yet very quiet location on the edge of the up-and-coming Werksviertel (see also (hidden) , (hidden) ) - not far from the main traffic hub Ostbahnhof and directly adjacent to Haidhausen. The Rohde & Schwarz factory site, the Technical Town Hall (with its round glass tower visible from afar) and the Telekom Towers are all within walking distance. Both the distinct nightlife in the former KunstparkOst and the Optimol area, as well as the extremely popular nightlife and strolling district of Haidhausen with its turn-of-the-century buildings and countless original shops, bars and restaurants are within walking distance and offer urban flair for every taste and every situation.

The Isar river, Praterinsel isle, Maximiliansanlage park, Muffathalle concert hall & beer garden, Müllersches Volksbad public art nouveau spa, Europe’s largest technology & science ‚Deutsches‘ Museum and the Gasteig culture palace  with its city library and current philharmonic hall are also about 10 minutes away by bicyle or just one S-Bahn (metro) stop away. The new Munich Philharmonic Hall is being built a stone’s throw from the flat (approx. 800m or a good half mile). 

From the Ostbahnhof, Munich's second biggest transport hub (all suburban trains, U4, U5, tram 19, many buses), which is about 9 minutes' walk away, you can get to not only to any quarter of Munich in a matter of a mere 20 min., but also to the entire surrounding agglomeration and suburbs without changing over trains. With the ‚S-Bahn‘ suburban trains you can reach by a matter of ...  

- 2 min. the hip Haidhausen district around Rosenheimer Platz (or a direct 5-10min walk) 
- 5 min. Munich's very centre ‚Marienplatz‘
- 8 min. the main rail station with many high speed ICE connections (Nuremberg 1h10, Frankfurt 3h15, Berlin 3h58, Cologne ~4h40)
- 15 minutes to the eastern business & tech campuses of Dornach, Feldkirchen, Unterföhring, Ismaning and the big Munich fare ground
- 30 min. to Munich International Airport
- From Ostbahnhof you also have direct long-distance connections to Rosenheim, Salzburg, Vienna, Kufstein, Innsbruck, South Tyrol (Railjet, Meridian, EC/IC) including some hotel/relief trains to Italy, Slovenia & Croatia (EuroNight, NightJet).

Within easy reach from the flat by bicycle in less than 10 min. are

 - the Isar river, Praterinsel isle, Gasteig culture palace, Müllersches Volksbad spa, etc.

By car in 
    • approx. 5 min. on the A8 motorway towards the south: the Alps, Salzburg, Tyrol, Italy...

Other

There is a dry looked room for bicycles available to all tenants of the building as well as a laundry drying room. Also an optional underground parking space on a quadruple hydraulic stack parker with a radio-controlled opener for front gate access can be booked in addition (dep. on availabiltiy). In front of the house there are also free of charge uncovered bicycle and car parking spaces.

In the inner patio, residents have access to a large lawn with a playground and a barbecue area for common use.
